stops.name: Nigel Mansell
stops.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1987/57/sunrise-over-silverstone ('This added only 20 seconds to lap 36'); Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1987_British_Grand_Prix ('On lap 35, Mansell was around two seconds behind his team-mate')
stops.note: unscheduled tyre stop for a vibration; the timing line is at the start of the pit lane, so the stop counts in lap 36's time and the in-lap is 35. The 20 s is time lost, not lane time

runningOrder.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1987_British_Grand_Prix: 'Prost ... took the lead, only to be passed by Piquet at Maggotts; Mansell soon followed his teammate'; https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/august-1987/57/sunrise-over-silverstone: 'going into Maggots Piquet passed him, and Mansell went through before Stowe'
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1987_British_Grand_Prix: 'On lap 35, Mansell was around two seconds behind his teammate.'
runningOrder.note: entered at the end of lap 34: lap 35 is Mansell's in-lap (he stopped at its end), whose synthetic time carries part of the stop loss; the source's gap is before the stop

notes: Piquet (#6) ran non-stop (Motor Sport). Prost (#1) stopped for tyres while third (no lap) and later retired with clutch failure (Jolpica: 53 laps).
